settings.headline: Support the museum, use the Study Vault
settings.subtitle: Members book Vault tables, see exhibition packets and get previews. Accounts are created at the desk; there is no registration form on this site.

settings.headline: What members get
settings.intro: All of this is behind sign-in on the members room.

items.title: Exhibition packets
items.text: Object lists, demo times and preview notes for current shows.

items.title: Collection favorites
items.text: Short lists of objects members request most in the Vault.

items.title: Member events
items.text: Vault evenings, pattern-book handling and exhibition previews.

settings.headline: How to join
settings.body: Ask at the Entry Hall desk. In the story, staff create the account when you join. This demo site has sample member and staff accounts for the Raytha example only.
settings.label: Sign in at /members to see packets and the winter member calendar.
